decisions.reason: It fits the firm's growing compliance focus and agency customer base, and because it stayed on its own page into 2024 the firm likely sees enough learning and cross-use with its existing hosting know-how to continue improving it.

As a homepage-featured flagship that directly builds on the firm's core hosting and platform capabilities, it is exactly the kind of product its in-house R&D and existing knowledge base can absorb and develop further.

A configurable managed hosting plan is very close to the established business, so the firm can interpret demand quickly, refine it with existing technical teams, and is unlikely to withdraw it after keeping it visible through 2024.

Although newer and less prominently presented, extended PHP security support still builds strongly on the firm's core operational and security expertise, making retention more likely than withdrawal while the firm learns from early market uptake.
